ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate the fastest route and avoid congestion, but a driver still needs steady hands to keep the stretcher from moving.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 12,300 Ambulance Drivers And Attendants, Except Emergency Medical Technicians employed in 2024, falling to a projected 12,100 by 2034. That is a net decline of roughly 200 jobs, with about 1,400 openings each year and a 2026 median annual wage near $34,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace ambulance drivers, but it will optimize work beyond driving. Systems take over dispatch, route planning, and trip records, while driver assistance helps monitor traffic. People remain necessary for complex-road judgment, emergency response under lights and sirens, and patient-moving teamwork. Drivers with first aid skills can also advance toward emergency care roles.
ai_s2_accel: Driver assistance and safety warning systems in vehicles
AI dispatch predicts high-demand areas and prepositions vehicles
Onboard terminals automatically connect emergency care data
Remote vehicle management supports fleet operations
ai_s2_auto: Automated dispatch assignments and optimal route generation
Digital trip records and vehicle status
Automatic reminders for fuel, maintenance, and equipment status
ai_s3_list: Driving judgment under lights and sirens: experience keeps the vehicle stable in chaotic traffic.
Patient moving and on-site teamwork: stairs, narrow passages, and slopes require strength and technique.
Sensitivity to patient condition: drivers also notice movement and changes in appearance during transport.
Response to sudden road conditions: people decide temporary detours around closures, crashes, and construction.
A calming presence: emergencies surround the vehicle, and a steady driver helps everyone remain steady.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score means the role has limited desk work, which is being automated. Systems handle dispatch, routes, and records.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Autonomous driving cannot cover emergency scenes under lights and sirens in the near term, so people remain central to driving and teamwork. The role itself is changing: drivers with emergency care skills can move toward responder roles, while purely driving positions narrow.

ai_s5_persona.建议: People with driving aptitude can earn a license, learn first aid, and join an emergency center or medical transport company. Combining driving and emergency care offers more growth than either skill alone.
Earn an emergency responder credential and advance from driver to a driver who can help save lives, then pursue dispatch or fleet management. Do not let the career stop at the steering wheel.
Drivers with B/A licenses can transition quickly into emergency care after additional first aid training. On a resume, highlight safe mileage, emergency response examples, and credentials.

Do not hire ambulance drivers based only on years behind the wheel. Evaluate emergency response and teamwork. Drivers with emergency care skills, steady attitudes, and strong driving ability are core fleet assets.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Dispatch assignments, optimal routes, and high-demand prepositioning
Automatic archiving of dispatch and transport information

ai_s7_trends: Dispatch and routing are becoming fully intelligent. Drivers shift from finding routes to focusing on driving and teamwork, while purely driving roles develop into combined positions.
Growing emergency transport demand encourages drivers with first aid skills to expand into responder work, blurring role boundaries.
Autonomous driving cannot cover emergency scenes in the near term, so driving judgment in complex traffic remains a key defense for ambulance drivers.

body: Ambulance Drivers And Attendants, Except Emergency Medical Technicians drive ambulances for emergency and medical transport, help injured and ill people enter, exit, and move, and provide basic care en route. They work closely with EMTs in prehospital systems.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate the fastest route and avoid congestion, but a driver still needs steady hands to keep the stretcher from moving.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能算出最快路线、提前避开拥堵，但最后那一把稳到让担架不晃的方向盘，还是得靠司机的双手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年救护车司机服务员、急诊医疗技术员在岗约 1.23 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.21 万人，岗位净减约 0.02 万个，年均产生约 0.14 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.43 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代救护车司机，但会优化驾驶之外的活。调度派单、路线规划、出车记录被系统接管，辅助驾驶也能帮忙看路况；但复杂路况的判断、警报状态下的临场应变和抬运配合，短期离不开人。会急救技能的司机还能往急救员方向延伸。
ai_s2_accel: 辅助驾驶与安全预警系统上车
AI 调度预判热点区域提前布车
车载终端自动衔接急救数据
远程车辆管理平台车队化运营
ai_s2_auto: 调度派单与最优路线自动生成
出车记录与车辆状态电子化
路况拥堵信息实时推送
油量、保养与设备状态自动提醒
ai_s3_list: 警报状态下的驾驶判断：路况再乱也要稳，这个判断靠经验。
抬运与现场配合：楼梯、狭道、坡地，怎么抬得稳是力气加技巧。
对患者状态的敏感：途中异动、脸色变化，司机的余光也在看。
突发路况应变：封路、事故、施工，临时改道靠人拍板。
稳定情绪的气场：车里车外都急，司机越稳，大家越稳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的桌面事务有限且正被自动化——调度、路线、记录都有系统代劳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。自动驾驶短期内覆盖不了警报状态下的急救场景，驾驶和配合的核心仍在人。真正被改变的是岗位形态：会急救技能的司机可向急救员延伸，纯驾驶的空间在收窄。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 有驾驶天赋的孩子可以先考驾驶证再学急救技能，进急救中心或转运公司。会开车加会急救的组合，比单一技能更有发展空间。
把急救员证书考下来，从「司机」变「会救人的司机」，再向调度或车队管理延伸。别让职业停在方向盘上。
持 B/A 证的司机转行进急救领域最快，补急救培训即可上岗。简历上多写「安全里程、应急处理案例、持证情况」。
招救护车司机别只看驾龄，要看应急处置和团队配合。会急救、心态稳、车技好的司机，是急救车队的核心资产。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 派单、最优路线、热点布车
出车、转运信息自动归档

ai_s7_trends: 调度与路线全面智能化，司机从「找路」转向「专注驾驶与配合」，纯驾驶岗向复合角色升级。
急救转运需求增长，会急救技能的司机向急救员延伸，岗位边界模糊化。
自动驾驶短期难覆盖急救场景，复杂路况下的驾驶判断仍是救护车司机的护城河。

body: 救护车司机与服务员负责驾驶救护车执行急救与转运任务，协助伤病员上下车与搬运，并在途中提供基础照料，是院前急救体系中与 EMT 紧密配合的运输保障岗位。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能算出最快路线、提前避开拥堵，但最后那一把稳到让担架不晃的方向盘，还是得靠司机的双手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Robotic arms can load and unload parts automatically, but an experienced operator still decides whether yellowing comes from old bath solution or insufficient processing time.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 14,600 Cleaning, Washing, And Metal Pickling Equipment Operators And Tenders were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 15,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 600 jobs, with about 1,600 annual job openings. The median annual salary is about $41,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI and automation will not eliminate the entire occupation soon, but they will keep reducing purely physical work. Robotic loading, PLC control, and automatic bath mixing replace button-only tasks. Operators still judge abnormalities, apply bath-process experience, handle minor equipment faults, and schedule loading. Process knowledge and machine-adjustment skills raise worker value.
ai_s2_accel: Vision systems inspect surface quality automatically
AI optimization and recommendations for process parameters
Digital shop-floor dashboards and traceability systems
ai_s2_auto: Robotic loading, unloading, and part transfer
PLC control of cleaning and pickling parameters
Automatic bath concentration testing and mixing
ai_s3_list: Bath-condition judgment: evaluate concentration, temperature, and contamination through observation and experience.
Exception handling: respond quickly to jammed parts and equipment alarms.
Process experience: know how and how long to clean different materials.
Safe operation: follow chemical protection and emergency procedures without shortcuts.
Loading schedules: arrange mixed, small batches efficiently.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this blue-collar occupation in the moderate automation exposure range. Program controls and robotic arms replace many repetitive actions, while field operation and process judgment still account for most work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: A score of 5 still creates risk for button-only operators. As automated equipment spreads, factories need people who adjust machines, understand processes, and resolve abnormalities. Moving toward process and equipment work turns automation into a competitive advantage.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Students choosing vocational education should avoid training for a single operating task. Study surface-treatment processes or mechatronics and build strong equipment-debugging and electrical foundations. Automated factories need people who work with machines, not people who only press switches.

Master bath mixing, process parameters, and equipment maintenance, then pursue relevant skill-level credentials. Automated lines still need experienced operators who can adjust machinery and solve quality problems.

Low entry barriers make this occupation suitable for working first and specializing later. Learn equipment adjustment and process knowledge after joining a factory, then move toward team leader or process technician roles. Purely physical work offers a narrowing path.

When installing automated equipment, retain technical operators who adjust machines and understand processes. Put process setup and equipment maintenance into promotion paths and use skill-based pay to retain them.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Control cleaning and pickling processes programmatically
Display production data in real time
Provide fault warnings and maintenance reminders

ai_s7_trends: Cleaning and pickling lines are becoming automated and enclosed. Robotic arms replace loading work, shifting people toward process and equipment tasks.
Stricter environmental rules drive waste-acid treatment and alternative processes, increasing demand for operators who understand greener methods.
Surface treatment is becoming digitally integrated with downstream plating and coating, turning process data into a core asset.

body: Cleaning, Washing, And Metal Pickling Equipment Operators And Tenders operate and monitor equipment that removes oil, rust, and scale from metal surfaces. They load parts, set programs, monitor processes, and inspect quality.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Robotic arms can load and unload parts automatically, but an experienced operator still decides whether yellowing comes from old bath solution or insufficient processing time.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 机械手能自动完成上下料，但「这批零件表面发黄，是槽液该换了还是时间没够」——这个判断，还得靠盯槽子的人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年金属设备操作员看护员在岗约 1.46 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.52 万人，净增约 0.06 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.16 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.15 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 和自动化不会立刻让整个岗位消失，但会持续压缩纯体力操作的比重。机械手上下料、PLC 自动控制、槽液自动配比，都在替掉「按钮工」的活。留下的是异常判断、槽液工艺经验、设备小故障处理和上下料编排——懂工艺、会调机的操作员反而更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 视觉系统自动检查表面质量
工艺参数 AI 优化与配方推荐
车间数字化看板与追溯系统
ai_s2_auto: 机械手自动上下料与工件转运
PLC 程序控制清洗酸洗参数
槽液浓度自动检测与配比
生产记录与报表自动生成
ai_s3_list: 槽液状态判断：浓度、温度、杂质，靠眼看鼻闻加经验。
异常处理：零件卡线、设备报警，现场要能快速兜住。
工艺经验：不同材质工件怎么洗、洗多久，配方在脑子里。
安全操作：化学品防护与紧急处置，马虎不起。
上下料编排：多品种小批量时怎么排最省时。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这是个自动化程度中等偏上的蓝领岗位：程序控制和机械手已经替代了一批重复动作，但现场操作和工艺判断仍是主要工作量。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高枕无忧——只做「按钮工」的人确实在减少。但反过来，自动化设备越普及，越需要会调机、懂工艺、能处理异常的人去盯着它们。往工艺和设备方向走，这 5 分反而帮你把竞争者甩开。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 孩子如果走技校路线，别只学单一操作岗。往表面处理工艺、机电一体化方向学，把设备调试和电气基础打扎实——自动化工厂要的是能跟机器打配合的人，不是只会按开关的人。
把槽液配比、工艺参数和设备维护学透，考取相关技能等级证书。自动线上了以后，能独立调机、解决质量问题的老师傅最不缺活。
这行入门门槛低，适合先就业再转型。进厂后多学设备调试和工艺知识，往班组长、工艺员方向走；纯干体力活的路会越走越窄。
上自动化设备时别只顾减人，要留得住会调机、懂工艺的技术型操作工。建议把「工艺调试 + 设备维护」能力写进晋升通道，用技能等级工资留人。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 程序化控制清洗酸洗流程

ai_s7_trends: 清洗酸洗工序向自动化与封闭式发展，机械手替代上下料，人员向工艺与设备端转移。
环保法规趋严，酸洗废液处理与替代工艺升级，懂绿色工艺的操作员需求上升。
表面处理与下游电镀涂装协同数字化，工艺数据沉淀成核心资产。

body: 金属清洗、洗涤与酸洗设备操作员操作并看护用于清除金属表面油污、锈蚀与氧化皮的清洗、洗涤和酸洗设备，完成工件装料、程序设定、过程监控与质量检查。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 机械手能自动完成上下料，但「这批零件表面发黄，是槽液该换了还是时间没够」——这个判断，还得靠盯槽子的人。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can assist triage and image interpretation, but physicians still make resuscitation decisions, perform procedures, and communicate with families.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 36,100 Emergency Medicine Physicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 37,100 by 2034, a net gain of about 1,000 jobs, with about 1,000 openings each year. The median annual wage was >=$239,200 in 2024, the highest BLS OES category (2026 collection).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Emergency Medicine Physicians, but it will reduce supporting tasks. AI accelerates triage and image recognition, shifting physicians from documentation toward rapid judgment, resuscitation, and high-pressure family communication. Pure triage registration will shrink, while physicians who make decisive treatment choices become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Rapid severity judgment: people make the decision.
Resuscitation procedures: people provide the hands-on skill.
Stability under pressure: people maintain composure.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates moderate exposure. Systems accelerate triage and image interpretation, but people still perform resuscitation and high-pressure communication.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high replacement risk. AI replaces triage registration tasks, not the physicians who save lives. Decisive emergency physicians who tolerate pressure become scarcer as systems increase efficiency.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Commit to the long clinical-medicine training path and practice emergency care and resilience. Pure triage work is shrinking in the AI era, so build resuscitation skills early.
Move from documentation toward rapid judgment, resuscitation, and coordination, then pursue an attending emergency physician role.
Highlight emergency qualifications and resuscitation cases, including the conditions you have managed.
Do not select physicians by academic scores alone. Assess performance under pressure. Senior clinicians who remain steady during resuscitation deserve competitive compensation.

ai_s7_trends: AI triage becomes standard, reducing registration work.
Population aging increases emergency-department demand.
Physicians who resuscitate effectively and make decisive choices become more competitive.

body: Emergency Medicine Physicians assess and resuscitate patients with acute and critical conditions. They coordinate triage, life support, specialty consultation, and transport so critically ill patients receive timely care.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can assist triage and image interpretation, but physicians still make resuscitation decisions, perform procedures, and communicate with families.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能分诊读片，但抢救决策、操作和家属沟通，还是医师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年急诊医学医师在岗约 3.61 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.71 万人，净增约 0.10 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.10 万个职位空缺，2024 年中位数年薪 ≥$239,200（BLS OES 最高档，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代急诊医师，但会压缩辅助动作。分诊与影像识别被 AI 加速，医师从写记录挪向快判、抢救、与家属的高压沟通。真正被挤掉的是只做分诊登记的，会抢救能决断的人更值钱。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光的医疗区——分诊读片被系统加速，但抢救和沟通还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是分诊登记动作，不是抢救生命的岗位。会决断、能扛压的急诊医师，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 走临床医学长线，多练急救与抗压，AI 时代纯分诊在缩，早点练抢救。
从写记录升级成快判加抢救加协调，争取急诊主治。
突出急诊资质和抢救案例，写清跟过哪些病种。
选人别只看成绩，要看扛不扛得住压。能稳抢救的骨干值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: AI 分诊普及，登记缩。
老龄化推升急诊需求。
会抢救能决断的更抢手。

body: 急诊医学医师负责急危重症的紧急评估与抢救，统筹分诊排序、生命支持、会诊协调与转运，保障危重患者得到及时处置。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能分诊读片，但抢救决策、操作和家属沟通，还是医师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can analyze forest change in a satellite image within seconds, but only teachers with field experience can explain the stand condition and help students understand it.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 1,600 Forestry And Conservation Science Teachers, Postsecondary employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 1,700 by 2034, adding about 100 jobs and producing roughly 100 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $100,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Forestry And Conservation Science Teachers, Postsecondary. Classroom theory, field instruction, research judgment, and student development require professional knowledge and experience. AI processes data, imagery, and literature efficiently, but teachers still take students into forests and build practical competence.
ai_s2_accel: Remote sensing and AI image analysis in research and teaching
ai_s2_auto: Assistance with course materials and lecture notes
Automated sample-plot data entry and statistics
ai_s3_list: Field instruction: identifying and explaining conditions on site.
Research judgment: choosing questions and designing studies.
Data insight: finding ecological patterns in observations.
Student guidance: building interest in nature.
Long-term commitment: physical endurance and patience in fieldwork.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means AI improves productivity without replacing the core role. AI handles much of the data processing, literature review, and image analysis. Field instruction, research judgment, and student development still depend on professional and interpersonal skills.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure requires active adoption of new technology. Forestry teachers who use remote sensing, AI monitoring, and carbon-sink models can produce stronger research and compete for grants. Scholars who ignore new tools risk falling behind in project and funding competition.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study forestry or ecology through the doctoral level. Prepare for a long path in a specialized discipline with a narrow employment market concentrated in agriculture and forestry universities and research institutes. Students need support for an academic life that combines fieldwork and sustained desk research.

Develop research in remote sensing, AI monitoring, and carbon sinks, which are growing areas. Lead field practicums and build original datasets. Field experience can become a distinctive research advantage.

Before moving from industry to higher education, assess your publication and grant record. Professionals from forest farms and protected areas can pursue practice-oriented teaching roles and use frontline cases in the classroom.

Agriculture and forestry institutions should assess more than publication counts. Teachers who can lead students in the field and use new technology are scarce. Adequate field-research funding improves retention.

ai_s7_trends: Remote sensing and AI monitoring are reshaping forestry research and teaching.
Carbon goals are increasing research on carbon sinks and ecological restoration.
Competition in higher education is increasing, and combined field and data skills carry more value.

body: Forestry And Conservation Science Teachers, Postsecondary teach and conduct research in forestry, forest ecology, and conservation. They teach professional courses, supervise field practicums and theses, and study sustainable forest management and ecological protection.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can analyze forest change in a satellite image within seconds, but only teachers with field experience can explain the stand condition and help students understand it.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能几秒钟分析一片卫星影像里的森林变化，但「这片林子的林相到底怎样、学生该怎么理解它」——只有带学生踩过样地的人知道。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年教师林业在岗约 0.16 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.17 万人，净增约 0.01 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.01 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.08 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代林业与保护科学教师：课堂上的理论讲解、野外的现场教学和科研判断都需要教师的专业功底与经验，育人这件事更是机器替代不了的。AI 能高效处理数据、影像和文献，但「把学生带进森林、教出真本事」依然靠人。
ai_s2_accel: 遥感与 AI 影像分析进入科研教学
AI 辅助物种识别与监测
虚拟仿真野外教学工具
ai_s2_auto: 样地数据自动录入统计
成绩与教学报表自动生成
ai_s3_list: 野外教学：现场指认与讲解的能力。
科研判断：选题与研究设计的功底。
数据洞察：从数据读出生态规律。
育人引导：激发学生对自然的兴趣。
长期坚守：野外作业的体能与耐心。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明高校教师处于「AI 明显提效、替代不了核心」的位置：数据处理、文献、影像分析被 AI 大幅接管，而野外教学、科研判断和课堂育人依然依赖教师的专业与人际能力。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中分意味着要主动拥抱新技术：会用遥感、AI 监测和碳汇模型的林业教师，科研产出和课题竞争力更强；对新技术无感的传统学者，会在项目和经费竞争中逐渐掉队。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想走这条路，本科选林学、生态学，之后一路读到博士。要做好长线准备：学科相对冷门，就业面窄，机会集中在农林院校和科研院所；家里要支持孩子「下得了地、坐得住桌」的学术生活。
把遥感、AI 监测、碳汇研究这些新方向捡起来，这是学科增长点。多带野外实习、多积累一手数据，把「跑野外」的独特优势转化成差异化竞争力。
从企业转高校的，先看自己的论文和课题积累够不够。林业系统从业者（林场、保护区）可以走实践型师资路线，用一线案例补教学短板。
农林院校招人别只看论文数，要看「能不能把学生带进林子里」。有野外科研能力、懂新技术的教师更稀缺，给足野外科研的经费支持才留得住人。

ai_s7_trends: 遥感与 AI 监测重塑林业科研与教学。
双碳目标带动碳汇与生态修复研究方向。
高校竞争加剧，野外 + 数据复合能力更吃香。

body: 林业与保护科学教师在高校从事林学、森林生态、自然保护区等方向的教学与科研，讲授专业课程、指导野外实习与论文，开展林业可持续经营与生态保护研究。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能几秒钟分析一片卫星影像里的森林变化，但「这片林子的林相到底怎样、学生该怎么理解它」——只有带学生踩过样地的人知道。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automated sorters can route mail by ZIP code, but a clerk still decides where an item with an unclear address belongs and traces billing discrepancies.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 67,400 Mail Clerks And Mail Machine Operators, Except Postal Service were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 62,900 by 2034, a net loss of about 4,500 jobs, with around 6,900 openings annually and a 2026 median annual wage of about $38,100 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Mail Clerks And Mail Machine Operators, Except Postal Service, and exposure is low. Automated sorting and electronic postage accelerate routine work, shifting clerks toward exception handling, reconciliation, and carrier coordination. Pure sorting faces pressure, while meticulous workers who understand accounts remain stable, and replacement is slow.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent pickup and delivery scheduling suggestions
ai_s2_auto: Automated sorting routes items by ZIP code
Shipping labels are generated and printed automatically
Tracking numbers are written back automatically
ai_s3_list: On-site operation: people clear paper jams.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this career in the low-moderate AI exposure tier. Equipment accelerates sorting and charging, while exception handling and reconciliation still depend on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure means limited risk. Automation replaces pure sorting and postage stamping, not end-to-end mailroom reconciliation. Meticulous clerks who understand accounts remain stable; workers limited to placing mail in slots face pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in administration or logistics and practice systems and reconciliation while studying. Pure sorting is contracting, so learn account reconciliation early.
Advance from sorting into reconciliation and coordination, learn carrier management, and pursue broader administrative duties.
Highlight accuracy and system experience, clearly stating the volumes handled. Organizations value stability and attention to detail.
When hiring, look beyond machine operation and assess attention to detail. Clerks who can reconcile accounts are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Automated sorting improves efficiency, reducing manual sorting.
Paperless processes reduce routine demand.
Clerks who can reconcile accounts remain stable.

body: Mail Clerks And Mail Machine Operators, Except Postal Service process correspondence and parcels in corporate, school, and institutional mailrooms, operate postage and sorting equipment, record tracking data, and coordinate carriers, serving as internal logistics hubs.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Automated sorters can route mail by ZIP code, but a clerk still decides where an item with an unclear address belongs and traces billing discrepancies.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动分拣机能按邮编走格口，但那封地址模糊的件归哪、账单对不平怎么追，还是文员的眼和手定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年邮件文员邮件机器操作员、邮政服务在岗约 6.74 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.29 万人，岗位净减约 0.45 万个，年均产生约 0.69 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.81 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代邮件文员，且曝光低。自动分拣与电子邮资把常规动作提速，文员从「分件」挪向「异常处理、对账、承运商协调」。真正被挤掉的是纯分捡，细心会理账的人更稳，且岗位替代速度慢。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的收发区——分件与计费被设备加速，但异常与对账还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光意味着风险小：被替代的是「纯分捡与过戳」动作，不是「收发对账」的岗位。细心、会理账的人，在机构里仍稳。怕的是只会照地址丢格口的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 行政/物流打底，在校多练系统与对账。AI 时代纯分捡在缩，早点练账。
从「分件」升级成「做对账 + 协调」，学承运商管理，争取兼行政。
突出准确与系统案例，写清跟过哪些量。机构看重稳和细。
选人别只看会操作，要看细不细。能理账的文员，值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 自动分拣提效，分捡缩。
无纸化压常规需求。
会对账的文员仍稳。

body: 邮件文员与邮件机器操作员（非邮政）在企业、学校与机构的邮件间处理往来信函与包裹，操作邮资机与分捡设备，记录追踪并对接承运商，是机构内部物流的收发枢纽。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自动分拣机能按邮编走格口，但那封地址模糊的件归哪、账单对不平怎么追，还是文员的眼和手定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automation can process data and fit models, but physicists still decide which phenomena deserve investigation and how to design experiments that can falsify hypotheses.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), in 2024 about 24,600 physicists were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 25,600, a net increase of about 1,000 jobs, with about 1,700 openings per year. In 2026, median annual pay was about $166,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace physicists, but it will accelerate routine stages. Automation takes over data collection, fitting, and simulation, shifting physicists from calculating efficiently toward asking precise questions, designing clever experiments, and making clear judgments. People who only perform repetitive calculations face displacement, while those who pose strong questions and design experiments become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Ask good questions: people provide intuition.
Design experiments: people develop falsification tests.
Judge signals: people distinguish real effects from artifacts.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 8/10 indicates high AI exposure in research. Systems accelerate data collection and simulation, but people remain essential for asking questions and designing experiments.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: High exposure does not equal high risk. Routine calculations are being replaced, not hypothesis-generating roles. Physicists who ask strong questions and design experiments become scarcer as productivity improves. Researchers who only perform repetitive fitting are vulnerable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build strong foundations in physics and mathematics and develop programming and experimental skills early. Pure calculation volume is shrinking in the AI era, so practice asking questions.
Advance from calculating efficiently to asking precise questions + designing clever experiments, master data and simulation tools, and seek experience with large-scale facilities.
Highlight modeling and experimental experience and specify the problems you have studied. Industry research and development values people who translate work into applications.
Do not assess candidates by publication count alone. Determine whether they can pose valuable questions. Core researchers who lead directions deserve resources.

ai_s7_trends: Large-scale facilities and automation become widespread.
Data-driven discovery becomes mainstream.
Physicists who ask strong questions are in greater demand.

body: Physicists study the fundamental laws of matter and energy, use mathematical modeling and experimental validation, propose and test theories about nature, and advance the boundaries of scientific knowledge and technology.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Automation can process data and fit models, but physicists still decide which phenomena deserve investigation and how to design experiments that can falsify hypotheses.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动化能跑数据和拟合，但哪个现象值得追问、怎么设计实验证伪，还是物理学家定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年物理学家在岗约 2.46 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.56 万人，净增约 0.10 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.17 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 16.63 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代物理学家，但会加速常规环节。自动化接管数据采集、拟合与模拟，物理学家从「算得动」挪向「问得准、设计得巧、判断得清」。真正被挤掉的是只做重复计算的人，能提出好问题、设计实验的人更值钱。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 8/10 说明这个职业处在高 AI 曝光的研究区——数据采集与模拟被系统加速，但提问与设计仍留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「跑常规计算」动作，不是「提出假设」的岗位。有提问力、能设计实验的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做重复拟合的物理学者。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 物理数学功底要硬，早点练编程与实验，AI 时代纯算量在缩，早点练提问。
从「算得动」升级成「问得准 + 设计巧」，学数据与模拟工具，争取大装置。
突出模型与实验经历，写清做过哪类问题。产业研发看重能落地的人。
选人别只看论文数，要看有没有提出好问题的脑子。能带方向的骨干值得给资源。

ai_s7_trends: 大装置与自动化普及。
数据驱动发现成主流。
能提问的物理学者更抢手。

body: 物理学家研究物质与能量的基本规律，运用数学建模与实验验证，提出并检验关于自然的理论，推进科学认知与技术边界。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自动化能跑数据和拟合，但哪个现象值得追问、怎么设计实验证伪，还是物理学家定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can handle lesson planning and records, but teachers still decide how to accompany children and steady their emotions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 555,100 preschool teachers, excluding special education, were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 578,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 23,000 jobs, with about 65,500 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $37,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace preschool teachers, but it will accelerate lesson planning and recordkeeping. Systems speed up lesson plans and developmental portfolios, shifting early childhood education and care from writing plans to attentive companionship, emotional care, and home-school partnership. Teachers who merely follow procedures are most vulnerable, while caring educators who understand observation will be more secure.
ai_s3_list: Companionship and care: human warmth matters.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 means this occupation has moderately high exposure. Systems accelerate lesson planning and records, but people retain their role in companionship and care.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low risk does not mean no impact. Writing plans and sending notices are accelerated, not the occupation's caregiving and companionship. Caring teachers with strong observation skills become more secure as efficiency improves. Those who only follow procedures face greater risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: While studying early childhood education, practice observation and care. AI is reducing plan-writing work, so develop companionship skills early.
Advance from following procedures to observation + home-school partnership, and study child development.
Highlight classroom leadership and case experience, clearly describing the children you have supported.
When hiring, look beyond qualifications to whether candidates combine compassion with sound judgment.

ai_s7_trends: Fully digital lesson preparation
Lower birth rates reduce demand
Caring educators who understand observation are more sought after

body: Preschool teachers, excluding special education, lead the kindergarten's daily routines and activities, coordinating care, habit formation, and early development. They apply child development knowledge and education-and-care skills to turn companionship into visible growth.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can handle lesson planning and records, but teachers still decide how to accompany children and steady their emotions.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能管备课与记录，但孩子怎么陪、情绪怎么稳，还是老师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年学前教育教师（不含特殊教育）在岗约 55.51 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 57.81 万人，净增约 2.30 万个岗位，年均产生约 6.55 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.71 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代学前教育教师，但会加速备课记录。系统把教案、成长册提速，保教从「写案」挪向「陪伴观察、情绪照护、家园共育」。真正被挤掉的是只念流程的，懂观察有爱心的人更稳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——备课记录被系统加速，但陪伴照护还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低风险不等于没影响：被加速的是「写案发通知」动作，不是「保教陪伴」的岗位。懂观察、有爱心的人，反而随提效更稳。怕的是只走流程的老师。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读幼师多练观察与照护，AI 时代写案在缩，早点练陪伴。
从「走流程」升级成「观察 + 共育」，学儿童发展。
突出带班与案例，写清陪过哪些孩子。
选人别只看资格，要看有没有爱心脑子。

ai_s7_trends: 备课全面数字化
少子化压需求
懂观察有爱心的人更抢手

body: 学前教育教师（不含特教）主导幼儿园一日生活与活动，统筹照护、习惯与早期发展，运用儿童发展知识与保教技能，把陪伴落成可感的成长。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能管备课与记录，但孩子怎么陪、情绪怎么稳，还是老师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Navigation can provide directions, but drivers still determine how to drive smoothly, care for passengers, and handle emergencies.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 243,900 shuttle drivers and chauffeurs were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 260,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 16,400 jobs, with about 36,300 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 is approximately $36,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace these jobs, but it will reduce dispatch time. Navigation and dispatch systems accelerate routing, shifting people from finding routes toward safe driving, hospitality, emergency response, and customer relationships. Standard-transport-only roles face displacement, while people who provide service and handle incidents become more valuable.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 means this occupation has low AI exposure. Driving and safety are central and systems cannot yet take over, though navigation will continue spreading.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not equal no risk. Automation replaces route finding and dispatch, not safe driving. People who provide hospitality and handle emergencies become scarcer as efficiency rises.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Develop driving and service skills. Standard transport is shrinking, so practice hospitality and emergency response early.
Advance from driving to hospitality + safety + customer service and pursue chauffeur or fleet roles.
Highlight years of driving and an accident-free record. Platforms value steady, courteous drivers.
Do not select people only by licenses; assess hospitality and incident response. Drivers who manage passengers well are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Navigation and dispatch are widespread, reducing route-finding work.
Safe driving receives greater emphasis.
Drivers with hospitality skills are increasingly sought after.

body: Shuttle and chauffeur drivers operate vehicles on fixed or reserved routes to transport guests and employees. They are responsible for safe driving, vehicle condition and cleanliness, and basic passenger service.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Navigation can provide directions, but drivers still determine how to drive smoothly, care for passengers, and handle emergencies.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 导航能带路，但车怎么开稳、客人怎么照顾、突发怎么处，还是司机的人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年穿梭车司机专车司机在岗约 24.39 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 26.03 万人，净增约 1.64 万个岗位，年均产生约 3.63 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.67 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代这类岗位，但会压缩派单时间。导航与派单系统把路线提速，人从「找路」挪向「安全驾驶、接待、突发处理、客户关系」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准接送的，会接待、能处理突发的人更值钱。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光——核心是驾驶与安全，系统暂时难接手，但导航会慢慢渗透。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「找路派单」动作，不是「安全驾驶」的岗位。会接待、能处理突发的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 练好驾驶与服务，纯接送在缩，早点练接待与突发。
从「开车」升级成「接待 + 安全 + 客户」，争取专车或车队。
突出驾龄与无事故，平台看重稳和礼貌。
选人别只看驾照，要看会不会接待和处置，能带客的骨干值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 导航派单普及，找路缩。
安全驾驶更被看重。
会接待的人更抢手。

body: 穿梭车与专车司机按固定或预约路线驾驶车辆，接送客人与员工，负责安全驾驶、车容车况与基本接待服务。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 导航能带路，但车怎么开稳、客人怎么照顾、突发怎么处，还是司机的人定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Monitoring systems can issue automatic alerts, but water and wastewater engineers still determine network layouts, perform hydraulic calculations, and coordinate construction.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), in 2024 about 368,900 water and wastewater engineers were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to rise to 387,500, a net gain of about 18,600 jobs, with approximately 23,600 openings each year. For 2026, the median annual wage is about $99,600 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace water and wastewater engineers, but it will reduce manual quantity calculations. Hydraulic modeling and monitoring accelerate design, shifting the occupation from manual flow calculations toward system design, hydraulic tradeoffs, upgrade strategies, and construction coordination. People who only calculate quantities are being displaced, while those who can design and coordinate become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: System design: people define the system.
Hydraulic tradeoffs: people make the choices.
Construction coordination: people turn plans into reality.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 means this occupation sits in a municipal field with medium AI exposure. Systems accelerate quantity calculations and alerts, but people remain essential for design and coordination.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-high exposure does not mean high risk. Manual quantity calculations are being replaced, not system-design roles. Water and wastewater engineers who can design and coordinate become scarcer and more valuable as efficiency improves. Those who only calculate quantities face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: When starting in environmental or civil engineering, develop knowledge of codes and hands-on execution. Pure quantity calculations are shrinking in the AI era, so build design skills early.
Advance from calculating water demand to developing plans + managing projects. Learn hydraulic modeling and seek responsibility for water-treatment plants.
Highlight municipal projects and field experience, clearly identifying the water plants you have supported. Employers value reliability and precision.
When hiring, look beyond attention to detail and assess whether candidates can think like designers. Core staff who coordinate effectively are worth premium pay.

ai_s7_trends: Monitoring spreads, reducing quantity calculations.
Upgrade projects create opportunities.
Professionals who can design and coordinate are in greater demand.

body: Water/Wastewater Engineers, with the Chinese title missing from the reference table, design the collection, conveyance, and treatment of drinking water and wastewater. They coordinate pipe networks, treatment plants, upgrades, and compliance.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Monitoring systems can issue automatic alerts, but water and wastewater engineers still determine network layouts, perform hydraulic calculations, and coordinate construction.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 监测能自动报警，但管网怎么定、水力怎么算、施工怎么协调，还是给排水定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年水与污水处理工程师在岗约 36.89 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 38.75 万人，净增约 1.86 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.36 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.96 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代给排水工程师，但会压缩手工算量。水力建模与监测把设计提速，给排水从「手算水量」挪向「方案设计、水力权衡、提标策略、施工协调」。真正被挤掉的是只做算量的，会设计能协调的人更值钱。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光的市政区——算量和报警被系统加速，但设计与协调还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「手工算量」动作，不是「方案设计」的岗位。会设计、能协调的给排水，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会算量的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 环境/土木起步多练规范和动手，AI 时代纯算量在缩，早点练设计。
从「算水量」升级成「做方案 + 管项目」，学水力模型，争取水厂。
突出市政项目和现场经验，写清跟过哪些水厂。企业看重稳和准。
选人别只看细心，要看有没有设计脑子。能协调的骨干，值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 监测普及，算量缩。
提标改造带来机会。
会设计能协调更抢手。

body: Water/Wastewater Engineers（中文名查表缺失）负责饮用水与污水的收集、输送与处理设计，统筹管网、水厂与提标达标。
